instruction: Enable VLC's minimal interface to remove the menu bar and display just the basic playback controls.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling VLC's minimal view mode (qt-minimal-view=1). The evaluator uses the existing check_qt_minimal_view function which reads the VLC config file and verifies that qt-minimal-view is set to 1 (enabled). This is similar in difficulty to the original task - both involve changing a single VLC configuration setting.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts VLC configuration file which contains the qt-minimal-view setting
Metric function check_qt_minimal_view correctly parses config file and looks for 'qt-minimal-view=' setting
Expected value is correct: expected_qt_minimal_view=1 correctly represents enabling minimal view mode as required by instruction
Postconfig appropriately kills and relaunches VLC to ensure config file is flushed to disk
Complete coverage: instruction requires enabling minimal view mode, evaluator verifies exactly this requirement
Data flow is semantically correct: config file extraction -> setting lookup -> comparison with expected value
Edge cases properly handled: FileNotFoundError, missing config line (default '0'), type conversion
Default value '0' (disabled) is correctly assumed when setting not found in config
